subject: legend.key opt ignored when geom is smooth

messages.author: 823ce0631d06de4a
messages.subject: legend.key opt ignored when geom is smooth
parts:
Hi, I am observing the following behavior:

> qplot(link.plr, app.plr, data=d, colour=group, geom="point") + opts(legend.key=theme_rect(colour="white"))

Legend key has a white background, as expected.

But when geom="smooth":

> qplot(link.plr, app.plr, data=d, colour=group, geom="smooth") + opts(legend.key=theme_rect(colour="white"))

Legend key now has a grey background.

Please advise. Thanks!

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: legend.key opt ignored when geom is smooth
parts:
Hi:

Without a reproducible example to check against, my guess would be
that you need to use fill = 'white' rather than colour = 'white', but
that's only a guess. Look at

https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/%2Bopts%28%29-List

Click on the Usage examples link under Legend Attributes and look for
legend.key(); that may help clear up some confusion.

HTH,
Dennis
